description: App Store customer reviews of one iOS app from Apple's public reviews feed: for each review the star rating, title, text, author name, app version, date and helpful-vote counts, 50 per page, newest or most helpful first, with the page's average rating. Give the numeric App Store id (or an apps.apple.com link) and a store country. Apple serves 10 pages (500 reviews) at most; an app with no reviews in that country is a 404 and not charged. Related tools on this server, for a different need: dev_apple_app_store_iphone when you need App Store iPhone app metadata from Apple's public iTunes; dev_mac_app_store when you need Mac App Store app metadata from Apple's public iTunes. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

id.description: App Store id, digits only, e.g. 310633997 (WhatsApp), or an apps.apple.com link that contains it
